image_description: A large adult Australian Pelican (Pelecanus conspicillatus) standing on a grassy and dirt surface, facing right. It has white plumage with black flight feathers visible on the folded wings, a long pinkish bill with a pale gular pouch, and blue-grey webbed feet. Beside it stands a small, dark-feathered pelican chick. In the background, there is green grass and a piece of driftwood.
